errors.text_span: Позициите са подредени по азбучен ред според българската абecedа.
errors.evidence: The bars in the chart are sorted in descending order based on their numerical value (13, 7, 6, 6, 5, 5, 5, 5, 4, 4), not alphabetically.

The y-axis scale, as indicated by the gridlines, extends beyond 13 (to at least 14), and the visible gridlines are at intervals of 2, not 1. The description of the scale is an unsupported fabrication.
The chart clearly shows four bars with the value of 5, but the description only lists three. The total number of bars described is 9, while the chart has 10.
The description fails to mention that the y-axis does not have a visible label, a detail noted in the reference description.
